reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Autovit (OLX Group) publishes an API doc (OAuth2) for professional accounts to create/read/update adverts, stats and vehicle taxonomy; no public search.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://www.autovit.ro/api/doc/): Autovit (OLX Group) publishes an API doc (OAuth2) for professional accounts to create/read/update adverts, stats and vehicle taxonomy; no public search. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
